items.note: Plan states the forward-invocation lemma and (X_a,Y_a)->(-Y_a,X_a) with restored scratch, and gives the bit-case coefficient argument (|S∩T| mod 2, side cancels intersection one). Missing the net change (JV+RG)x independent of scratch, the complex case, and the three-stage composition (x,y)->(x,y+x)->(-y,y+x)->(-y,x); h=100, N, m are never given.
S1.2 gives D_out S_Omega D_in^{-1} and the route operator eps_w D_sink(rho(w)) D_source(w)^{-1} exactly as at 813-822; the reason (a common frame commutes with a pointwise gate) is not given.

Comparable nondegenerate labels, the budget Wm-2N+2L via telescoping at gates, and L/N=100/539, 101/539 are stated correctly. Missing the labels' construction in F^{⊗3} (dimension m), that the only decreasing edges are central wires 3->4 losing h, and L=Ich; the residual table that the derivation rests on is absent.

S1.3.4 gives s_b=W_b m-N+2L_b<W_b m correctly, but the endpoint identity M_sink(rho(w))-M_source(w)=I_m, the projections and -P_{U_a} source matrices, and the resulting shear H<-H+D on every role are absent (S1 only says 'a shear realized by a fixed bit network').

S1.3.5 correctly says each edge's phase-frame difference is one translation kernel per orthonormal residual vector and s_c<W_c m, but omits the frames C_U, the formula s_c=W_c m-2N+2L_c, and that the roles receive C^{⊗m} after diagonal corrections.

Plan goes from L/N<1/2 to s<Wm and from deficits >20·2^{-50} to s/W<m^tau with tau=sigma=1-2^{-50}, as in the paper. The exact eta values and the step log m<20, m^{1-2^{-50}}>m(1-20·2^{-50}) are missing, and the deficit N-2L is never made explicit.
Only 'relies on: stream-scans' and 'single-bit moves' in S3.5; no step states the O(V) operations or the controlled-shift lemma.

S1.4 and S1.5 restate Lemmas lem:lower-lower and lem:matrix-shear faithfully (A=E_1 Pi E_2, a ones; exactly a interchanges plus O(V)). Neither the elimination proof nor the D<-D+H, swap, D<-H-D trick is given.

Recurrence F_k<=(s/W)F_{k-1}+O(1), s calls on volume V/W, and the geometric sum giving O(e^tau) match 1543-1557. The row-field divisibility hypothesis, the cyclic split into W role streams, the three-update interchange D<-D-H, H<-H+D, D<-H-D and the fixed-tape depth-first schedule (O(V) per node) are missing.
S1/S1.7 state O(Vu^tau) for two disjoint u-bit chunks with fixed tau<1; no reduction from power widths (row digits, padding, base-m pieces) is given.

S2.1 says the residual operator becomes a product of two-point kernels on selected directions, but there is no P_M conjugation, no s_c child calls of C^{⊗f} on e/m axes, no inverse-child identity and no H_0^{⊗D}=b^D S_D C^{⊗D} S_D.
No step concerns packed row additions on selected bits.
No step gives the layer recurrence F(e)<=(s/W)F(e/m)+O((eK)^tau+1) or its unrolling; S2 jumps directly to O(Vd^{lambda'}).

S2 gives H_0 on D<=d selected bits in O(Vd^{lambda'}) with one final truncation, but omits K=floor(d^c), the output Q_p(Hz), the error <sqrt2 2^{-p} and the guard-bit exact evaluation; S2.2 only restates the procedure's existence.

Contraction, F_t^+F_t^-=t^{-1}I, the stored order B_t F_t^- / F_t^+ B_t^{-1}, rounds as parallel butterfly plus J_E, and the common-offset layout follow the paper. The layout permutation L, the error <sqrt2 l 2^{-p} and the cost O(Tp[dK+pK^{tau-1}+l d^{lambda'}]) are absent.
S4.2 restates the lemma (exact numerators, Q_p(fg/r) in O(rp log(rp))) and S4.1 names signed Kronecker substitution; B_0=2^{4p}, the four products and centered residues are not given.
M_r=(f*g)/T as a bilinear contraction and the error sqrt2 M(3l+1)2^{-p} are correct; the cost bound and the commutation P(LBu,LBv)=LB P(u,v) are missing.

Hypotheses (coprime s<t, t/s-1>p/alpha^4) and contractions A, B_0 are stated, but the identity P_sF_s=2^{2alpha^2}B_0P_tF_tA, its tensor form RF_s=2^gamma B_0 Q F_t A, the errors and the costs are not.

S6.2 gives (RF_s^+)[(RF_su)(RF_sv)]=(u*v)/S^2 correctly; S6.1 gives the chirp formula but drops the target permutation Q (paper: QF_t u = conj(a)(a*(conj(a)u))/T). The 'complete the square' method matches the paper's coefficient check, but the R-cancellation argument is not given.
Only tau=sigma=1-2^{-50} and kappa=2^{-182} appear; b, p=6b, d, K, T, the prime lengths s_i and the other exponents are absent.
The triangular formula b_i=a_i+mu_i sum_{j<i}a_jP_j mod s_i is correct, but Phi (x -> prod x_i^{mu_i}), mu_i and the isomorphism preserving cyclic convolution are never defined.
x_d -> zeta y with zeta=e^{pi i/r} is correct, but the isometric isomorphism, the wrap check and M_C=D_- iota^{-1} M_r(iota D_+ f, iota D_+ g)=(f*g)/T are missing.

The six steps are listed correctly (digits, Phi, two transforms, product, opposite transform scaled by S giving w=(u*v)/S, rounding, carries). The source-transform composition (A, chirp, B_0, 2^gamma), the digit scaling 2^{-b-2} and the second scale 2^{2b+4}S are missing.
Final error <1/2 so rounding is exact is stated, but the error chain E_s=9·2^gamma TL, E_w<28·2^gamma T^2L and 448b 2^{-3b/4}<1/2 (needing gamma<=b/4) is absent.
min margin 2^{-181}=2kappa and O(Tp p^{1-kappa})=O(n(log n)^{1-kappa}) are correct, but the cost-table rows and that the minimum is g_2=epsilon c(1-tau) are not given.
S0 relies on 'sch-conjecture' and motivates by the n log n scan cost, but never states the liminf/negation argument.

errors.says: method: three stages of scalar invocations, 'each stage is a forward schedule'
errors.paper: Stage 2 is the inverse forward schedule from Y to X, effecting X<-X-Y; only stages 1 and 3 are forward invocations
There are three stages, each consisting of v^2 separate invocations (I=3v^2); each X_a is touched by one invocation per stage
The identity is for QF_t u, the transform including its target coordinate permutation Q; this is why Q is never executed

chain: The movement half follows the paper's route: bank-exchange network, frame identity, label budget Wm-2N+2L, L/N<1/2, s<Wm, Bruhat shear with a interchanges, and the recurrence F_k<=(s/W)F_{k-1}+O(1) giving O(Ve^tau). It thins out at the endpoint identity M_sink-M_source=I_m that turns the network into the shear H<-H+D, which is never stated. The arithmetic half is much thinner: the phase-frame recursion is only alluded to, and the packed selected-bit addition and layer recurrence are missing, so O(Vd^{lambda'}) is asserted rather than reached. The rest of the pipeline (resampling, chirp, CRT, twist, convolution, recovery, cost table) is mostly restated conclusions without the identities or error and cost bounds that connect them to the final margin 2kappa.

steps.note: The exchange (X_a,Y_a)->(-Y_a,X_a) with restored scratch and 'invocations over triples' are present, but h=100, indexing by triples in T^3, N=binom(h,3)^3 and m=h^3 are never given.

D_out S_Omega D_in^{-1} and the route operator are stated in their role. The justification (a common frame commutes with the pointwise gate) and the explicit point that edges cost only frame changes are left implicit.
Only 'every edge joins comparable nondegenerate labels'; no subspaces of F^{⊗3} of dimension m, and the plan never says that only central wires 3->4 decrease, each by h.
S1.3's method only 'bounds' edge rank by residual dimension. P_V-P_U having rank dim V-dim U is not stated, nor are the N rank-one source exceptions (the -N in S1.3.4 appears without explanation).
Both formulas are given: sum |Delta dim|=Wm-2N+2L by gate telescoping, and s_b=W_b m-N+2L_b. L=Ich is not stated.
L/N=100/539 and 101/539, both below 1/2, and s<Wm are stated; the deficit N-2L>0 is implied rather than written.
S1 only says the interchange is 'a shear realized by a fixed bit network'. The endpoint identity M_sink(rho(w))-M_source(w)=I_m and the shear H<-H+D on every role are absent.
E_1 Pi E_2 with a ones, exactly a interchanges plus O(V), and 's calls' per node (S1.6 motivation, S1 motivation on rank) are present.
Children of volume V/W, F_k<=(s/W)F_{k-1}+O(1), s/W<m^tau with tau=1-2^{-50} from deficits >20·2^{-50}, and F_k=O(e^tau) are present. The log m<20 step is omitted.

central.summary: The plan reconstructs the arithmetic of the saving: the frame identity, the budget formulas, L/N<1/2 giving s<Wm, the Bruhat shear making edges into rank-many calls, and the recurrence to e^tau with tau=1-2^{-50}. It omits the concrete network parameters (h, N, m), the label construction with its single decreasing edge type, why rank equals dimension change (with the N source exceptions), and the endpoint identity that makes the network a shear H<-H+D. So the reason s has its value, and why the network performs the interchange at all, are only gestured at.
